target_name: Discretionary Cash Earnings With Net Runway
rationale: This is a one-leg cosmetic swap of the archived "Cash Earnings After Mandatory Outflows" (gross → net runway), and the stated motivation is factually wrong since that archived signal already achieves 0.106 coverage without oancf while gross and net runway alone were shown to be near-identical (alpha 6.4/t5.25 vs 6.1/t5.24), so essentially no new information is being tested.

Merging the operating-cost and contractual denominators is economically coherent, but it is a third denominator variant of an already twice-tested runway conjunction whose likely outcome is an interpolation between the two known results, and the skewness argument is weak since both existing versions are already winsorized and rank-transformed.

The interaction question is legitimate and distinct from the MIN/MUL-of-ranks constructions, but a bare product of two z-scores without the main effects in the regression is not a clean cross-partial — its long leg pools the safest firms (both z high) with unprofitable-and-illiquid firms (both z negative), which directly contradicts the hypothesized economics and the positive expected sign.

target_name: Buffer Stock Against Cash Need Volatility
rationale: Scaling a liquid stock by the volatility rather than the level of operating cash needs is a genuinely untested precautionary-savings mechanism in this archive, the ratio is approximately scale-free and winsorized, and the sign is unambiguous; the main residual risk is that five-year volatility windows both cut coverage and tilt toward mature stable firms.

target_name: Thin Runway Into A Maturity Wall
rationale: The claim that the two legs capture "distinct hazards" is undermined by mechanical overlap — dlc is subtracted in the runway numerator and is the numerator of the second leg — so the product substantially squares near-term debt exposure rather than isolating a genuine two-hazard conjunction; using gross rather than net runway would fix this.

Three-year smoothing of one leg of an already-tested conjunction is a cosmetic timing variant, and the closely related "Runway At Its Own Five-Year Low" already showed that time-series transformations of this ratio destroy rather than improve the signal.
